Package com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.exporters

Class ImageTagBufferedImage

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Image
java.awt.image.BufferedImage
com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.exporters.ImageTagBufferedImage
All Implemented Interfaces:
RenderedImage, WritableRenderedImage, Transparency
public class ImageTagBufferedImage extends BufferedImage
BufferedImage that has link to ImageTag. This is mainly used for PDF export coupling.
